title: The Moral Foundations of Left-Wing Authoritarianism: On the Character, Cohesion, and Clout of Tribal Equalitarian Discourse
reasoning: The paper extensively evaluates the 'Moral Foundations' of political discourse using Moral Foundations Theory (MFT). It analyzes moral signatures across domains such as Harm, Fairness, Ingroup loyalty, Authority, and Purity (sanctity), and discusses the ethical implications of these foundations in the context of political authoritarianism.
